DML.SELECT: SELECT ext_entity_type_id as "extEntityTypeId", ext_entity_subtype_id as "extEntitySubtypeId", ext_entity_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", uid as "uid", coordinates as "coordinates", auto_route as "autoRoute", last_update as "lastUpdate", generated_at as "generatedAt", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ext_entities WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ext_entities (ext_entity_type_id, ext_entity_subtype_id, ext_entity_id, alias, description, uid, coordinates, auto_route, last_update, generated_at, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:extEntityTypeId, :extEntitySubtypeId, :id=getNextValFromSec{'rt.last_ext_entities_id'}, :alias, :description, :uid, :coordinates, :autoRoute, :lastUspdate, :generatedAt, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ext_entities SET alias = :alias, description = :description, coordinates = :coordinates, auto_route = :autoRoute, last_update = lastUpdate, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ext_entity_type_id = :extEntityTypeId AND ext_entity_id = :id
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ext_entities WHERE ext_entity_type_id = :extEntityTypeId AND ext_entity_id = :id
